::: {.section-intro}
I build and lead open-data communities and FAIR data tooling for the water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) sector, and I write and manage the grants that fund them.
:::

## Open Data & Software

### [AGUASAN Workshop 2027 - Publishing WASH Data Together](https://github.com/Global-Health-Engineering/aguasan)
AGUASAN Community of Practice / SDC Water Network 

2026 - Current 

- Author of a topic proposal for a five-day working retreat where WASH-sector participants publish datasets while learning Git/GitHub, Quarto and safe use of AI agents; bridges academia (ETH), the WASH community and Swiss government. 



### [dataitd24 - data from the FAIRqual workshop at ITD24](https://fairqual.github.io/dataitd24/)
Maintainer 

2026 - Current 

- R data package with the data of the FAIRqual workshop at the ITD24 conference (Utrecht, November 2024): digitised flipcharts, a qualitative codebook with 50 codes and the workshop documentation; v1.0.0 released in February 2026.
- Includes an article comparing the GitHub to Zenodo and the SWISSUbase publishing workflows.
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18493525 



### [Qualitative Data Governance for Transdisciplinary and Participatory Research - e-learning module](https://courses.openlearnity.org/learning/course/course-v1:ETH_domain+qualitative+datagovernance/home)
Co-author 

2026 - Current 

- Open e-learning module on the ETH Domain Data Management Campus (ETH Board ORD Program, Measure 3 Open Educational Resources), published in September 2026. Contributed to the unit on levels of access and data repositories (Unit 4.3.2).
- Mohr, F., Marqués, L., Reifenrath, J., Schöbitz, L., Simon, L., & Chapman, M.
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23016356 



### [fairenough - tidy data into documented R packages](https://openwashdata.github.io/fairenough/)
Author 

2025 - Current 

- Converts tidy data into R packages with documentation websites and AI-assisted descriptions. 



### [jmpwashdata - WHO/UNICEF JMP data](https://github.com/larnsce/jmpwashdata)
Author 

2024 - Current 

- R package providing tidy access to WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme WASH data. 



### [Data Science for openwashdata (ds4owd)](https://ds4owd-001.github.io/website/)
Course Creator & Instructor 

2023 - Current 

- Designed and taught two free online cohorts on literate programming with Quarto and R; hundreds of participants across many countries.
- Focus on data management, reproducibility and publishing open data. 



### [washr - R package for publishing openwashdata resources](https://openwashdata.github.io/washr/)
Author 

2023 - Current 

- An R package that makes publishing openwashdata data resources easier. 



### [openwashdata community](https://openwashdata.org)
Founder & Community Lead 

2022 - Current 

- Built and lead a global open-data community for the WASH sector; 90+ open datasets published as documented R data packages.
- Created the {washr} and {fairenough} R packages that turn tidy data into FAIR, documented data packages.
- See openwashdata.org 



### [rstatsZH - open course materials & infrastructure](https://rstats.zuerich/)
Creator & Maintainer 

2021 - Current 

- Built and maintain the open, reusable course materials, website templates and Git-based infrastructure behind the rstatsZH training programme (course delivery is under Teaching). 

## Grants & Funding

::: aside
Wrote and managed a portfolio of ETH Board Open Research Data grants worth roughly CHF 500,000 in total (2023-2026).
:::

### [openwashdata - establishing Data Stewards and increasing FAIRness](https://github.com/openwashdata-dev/prop-eth-ord-explore-02-openwashdata)
ETH Board ORD Program (Explore, 2nd call) 

2024 - 2026 

- Wrote the proposal and managed the project (Prof. Elizabeth Tilley, PI). Placed funded data stewards in partner organisations (UKZN, South Africa; BASEflow, Malawi) and delivered a 12-module data stewardship training programme. 



### [FAIRqual - FAIR Data Practices for Qualitative Research in Transdisciplinarity](https://github.com/fairqual)
ETH Board ORD Program (Explore, Measure 1) 

2024 - 2026 

- Co-wrote the proposal and contributed to the project (team across TdLab and Global Health Engineering, ETH Zurich). Developed tools and standards for sharing hard-to-anonymise qualitative research data following FAIR principles. 



### [washcollab - Enhancing Global WASH Data Accessibility through Collaborative Initiatives](https://github.com/openwashdata-dev/prop-eth-ord-contribute-washweb)
ETH Board ORD Program (Contribute) 

2024 - 2025 

- Wrote the proposal and managed the project (Prof. Elizabeth Tilley, PI). A partnership between WASHWeb and openwashdata that maintained open-source tools for authoritative WASH data (WHO/UNICEF JMP, World Bank, UN-Water GLAAS, OECD). 



### [openwashdata - Open WASH data by building Open Science Competencies and Community](https://github.com/openwashdata-dev)
ETH Board ORD Program (Explore, 1st call) 

2023 - 2024 

- Wrote the proposal and managed the project (Prof. Elizabeth Tilley, PI). Built the infrastructure, community and FAIR data publishing workflow for open WASH data; 18 months. 



### [openjmp - Open JMP: unlocking the potential of global indicator data](https://ghe.ethz.ch/open-science/projects/openjmp.html)
ETH Board ORD Program (Contribute) 

2023 - 2024 

- Wrote the proposal and managed the project (Prof. Elizabeth Tilley, PI). In partnership with the WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme, turns decades of WASH coverage data into documented open R packages; 15 months. 

## Proposals

### SDSC openwashdata - Reviewed, open data publishing for the WASH sector, end to end at pilot scale
Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC), National Call 2026 (Collaboration and Expertise Request) 

Submitted 2026 

- Wrote the proposal as PI (Prof. Elizabeth Tilley, co-PI). Requests six months of SDSC engineering time, as a Proof of Concept, to turn the openwashdata publishing pipeline into a service on secure ETH infrastructure that takes submitted files to a reviewed, citable data package. 



### [FAIR by doing - A hands-on programme that trains ETH researchers to make their own research data FAIR and to declare their use of AI tools](https://github.com/Global-Health-Engineering/fair-training)
ETH FAIR Competence Funding (2nd call) 

Submitted 2026 

- Wrote the proposal as corresponding applicant, with Adriana Clavijo Daza. A twelve-month programme from 1 February 2027 in which fifteen ETH researchers, mostly postdoctoral researchers and doctoral students, take a dataset of their own to a published, citable data package and declare their use of AI tools. 



### Swiss-Ghana partnership - Building Computational Research Competencies: A Swiss-Ghana Partnership for Open Science Capacity Development
Swiss Leading House Africa, Research Partnership Grant 2025-2028 (SERI, Swiss TPH with the University of Basel) 

Not funded 2025 

- Wrote the proposal (Prof. Elizabeth Tilley, Swiss PI; Dr. Eugene Appiah-Effah, KNUST, Ghana). A ten-month programme with a one-week bootcamp at ETH Zurich for eight KNUST researchers from the ds4owd course, followed by remote mentorship in Open Science workflows.
